entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Heavy)

system.description: Once per map, as a Bonus Action, you may heal 2d6 + Mgt HP and restore 1d4 Stn. At 10th level, gain another 1d6 healing on your HP roll. At 20th level, gain another 1d4 on your Stn recovery roll.
Upon defeating an opponent, heal 2d6 HP and recover 2 Stn.
A heavy axe with a broad blade. Simple to make and easy to swing.
